title: Email Templates — Create / Edit
overviewHtml: The text of an email the system sends — notifications, reminders, payslips, bulk passwords. Placeholders written as $#TokenName#$ in the subject and body are replaced using the template's email tokens.

fields.label: Code
fields.rules: Optional. Maximum 64 characters. Left blank, the next number is assigned when the record is saved. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html:
What it is. A short code that identifies this item in its list.

Example. 001

fields.label: NameEn
fields.rules: Required. Maximum 256 characters. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in English.

fields.label: NameAr
fields.rules: Required. Maximum 256 characters. Must be unique in this list.
fields.html: What it is. The item's name in Arabic.

fields.label: SmtpProfile
fields.html:
What it is. The mail server profile to send from.

Why it matters. Not read at present.

fields.label: Subject
fields.html:
What it is. The email's subject. Placeholders are replaced.

Example. Leave resumption reminder for $#EmployeeName#$

fields.label: EmailBodyHtml
fields.html: What it is. The email's body, as HTML. Placeholders are replaced.

fields.label: EmailBodyText
fields.html:
What it is. A plain-text version of the body.

Why it matters. Where filled in, it is used instead of the HTML body for emails sent straight to an address, and the bulk password email needs it.
